sourceBoundDiagnosis.supportedMechanism: Pinned public auth-add and auth-list both load the credential pool. On this single-use OAuth provider, load_pool invokes the fork healer before reading entries. The healer identifies copied lineage by matching row ID or token material, removes the matched profile copy, and retains a row without a root counterpart. A profile row shadows root fallback; after healing leaves no profile row, public profile auth/chat reloads the root-owned row.
sourceBoundDiagnosis.minimumFixture: Create the root row with public auth-add and the existing fake OAuth device flow, then copy that synthetic temporary auth.json byte-for-byte into profiles/toy/auth.json through one declared OS fixture control. A fresh public profile auth-list invokes the real healer. Hashes, public list output and subsequent fresh process generations can bind copy, removal and root ownership without loading private auth functions or exporting credential bytes.
sourceBoundDiagnosis.independentGrant: After copied-lineage healing and root refresh/reload, use public profile auth-add with a different fixed actor and label. The external fake returns the existing added generation, whose synthetic subject/account and refresh token differ from the root initial lineage. Public profile readback must show exactly one row with the independent label; public profile chat then refreshes added to added-rotated. Root digest must remain unchanged across independent add and independent refresh.
sourceBoundDiagnosis.noSchemaExpansion: HermesAuthFixtureResultV1 already records public argv, process identity, provider, phase, access/catalog generation, HTTP ledger, denial/socket state and token hygiene. Existing CheckView evidence can carry nonsecret before/after root/profile digests and copy-equality facts. Keep the canonical V1 result; add no DTO, protocol, service or route unless implementation demonstrates a specific missing AT oracle.

sourceReferences.finding: AT89 is assigned to the CLI rung, exact assertion hash and canonical source digest above.

Unfiltered auth registration currently stops at AT88. AT88 already demonstrates exact manifest validation and dispatch to the existing auth fixture; AT89 needs its corresponding guard, manifest assertion and mixed-lineage mode call.

The existing owner already runs fresh pinned public children, uses temporary root/profile homes, checks exact argv/identity/provider ledgers and hashes root auth.json, root .env and profiles/toy/auth.json. Add one explicit mixed-lineage sequence and OS-only synthetic store-copy setup.

The existing external HTTP fake has initial/rotated and added/added-rotated generations, request/refresh ledgers, deterministic generation claims, and a child-local fake clock for chat-expired. Extend fixed actors and strict generation expectations only; no new endpoint or barrier protocol.
HermesAuthFixtureResultV1 supports add/list/chat phases, provider generations, process identity, HTTP counts, hygiene and denial/socket observations needed for the planned cells.
AT88 supplies the current behavioral manifest shape: exact mandatory case-to-phase mapping, external clock fault control, grouped independent observation and SIM-unavailable reason.
Pinned Codex auth-add is public OAuth/device-code flow; it loads the provider pool and creates a distinct PooledCredential. Public auth-list also loads the pool and displays row count and label.
The healer uses expiry metadata/JWT exp, recognizes copied row ID or shared token material rather than account identity, removes matching profile copies, and preserves independent rows.
load_pool calls the public-runtime lineage healer before reading provider entries.
Profile entries take precedence when present; otherwise reads use the root provider entries, which makes post-heal profile chat exercise the root owner.

Profile digest changes from the copied bytes after real load_pool healing; root auth and .env digests stay unchanged. No store bytes enter output.

limitsAndDeferrals: The baseline proves NOT_IMPLEMENTED only; this plan is not an implementation or acceptance pass.

The matrix would prove this synthetic Codex lineage in a disposable CLI world. It does not prove real credentials, live OAuth accounts, installed Hermes mutation, service identity, production containment, or protected/root-role behavior.
Process identity records PID/PPID/UID/GID only; UID 501 must not be interpreted as service identity.
AT35's Anthropic singleton/PKCE, other providers, real-home data, and any separate native/controller/service gates remain outside AT89 and unproved.
Do not change `wholeATComplete` to true from this subset; retain zero live provider sends and preserve installed Hermes, profiles, services, accounts and files.
